description.value:
Normalized Heritage (RFI v1.0). Ported to Roll for Initiation: 7-damage-type canon, Soma Break, Tier-based scaling, reroll-lowest. Replaces the D&D5E heritage draft dated 2026-04-19 00:10.

“There is a place older than Hell. You remember being there. It remembers you back.”

Qliph-Scarred (Chthonic). Mode: rooted downward. The scar goes through strata older than judgment.

Heritage Traits

  • Creature Type. Humanoid (Qliph-Scarred).
  • Size. Medium. Speed: normal.
  • Old-Dark Vision. You see clearly in darkness to 60 ft, and in colour rather than greyscale — the deep-dark’s own palette, not the surface’s.
  • Underworld Passage. Your signature feat (below) gives you a door.
  • Signature. You gain What the Deep Dark Taught You at character creation.

Engine note. Where this heritage grants a damage-type resistance, it is applied by the fourththing defense engine via flags.fourththing.grants. Narrative immunities (sleep, forced movement, cold iron) are descriptive only until the Phase 3 condition-and-flavor engine ships.

advancement.title: What the Deep Dark Taught You
advancement.hint: Gain the Qliph-Scarred (Chthonic) signature feat: What the Deep Dark Taught You.
